title: Chapter 32 Camping Outside The City
content:
Chapter 32 Camping Outside The City

Only more than 1,000 refugees finally decided to leave on their own, and these people were all confident in their own strength.

Like half of the Scarface Kobold team who are going back, they are very confident.

Nearly 7,000 people stayed. Many people chose safety and security at the last moment. They did not have strong risk control capabilities in the wild and there was no need to risk their lives.

This result, for Wu Qingwei, was unexpectedly good.

As long as you go to Daxia collar, you can always make some contributions to Daxia collar.

After all the teams that chose to leave on their own left, the huge team headed for Daxia Territory began to set off.

Wu Qing mobilized most of the Zerg troops to ensure the safety of the refugees.

He also left a Zerg army behind to clean up the traces of the team's journey and interfere with others' tracking through various methods.

He also used puppies to track each team that left, with the purpose of finding the location of other territories.

Understanding the territory distribution in this area as soon as possible will help him implement various plans in the future.

After rushing all afternoon, nearly 7,000 refugees finally arrived in Daxia Territory before dark.

Standing on a hill not far from the small town of Daxia, looking at the extremely small city in front of me, countless refugees stood in a mess in the wind!

"Is this the Great Xia Leader?!"

"In such a small city, there are so many of us, where do we live? What do we eat?!"

This is a torture from the soul.

Everyone was just trying to escape, and basically lost everything they could, otherwise they wouldn't be able to get here.

Can the Great Xia Territory accept so many of them now?

"This may be just a subsidiary territory of Daxia Territory. Think about it, can such a big city support so many troops?"

"Don't think too much! Don't worry!"

Someone comforted.

"That makes sense, but tonight is going to be difficult for everyone!"

This sentence is indeed correct, because the city is so big, and since everyone is already here, it is impossible to move around at night, so tonight will be more difficult.

Wu Qing was scratching his head now. There were more refugees than he expected. If they all entered the city, the whole town would have to be crowded.

Without entering the city, the current luck of the Great Xia Territory is not enough to adjust and expand the scope of the lord's core protection zone. If the refugees are outside the city, they are providing benefits to Weiyi.

Although the Zerg can clean up the weirdness in the area where the lord's protection is weakened outside the city, weirdness is difficult to guard against. Other races do not have the adaptability of the Zerg. If something goes wrong, it will affect the image and luck of the territory.

This won't work, and that won't work. In the end, there is only one way left, which is to endure the pain and convert the system's Qi into the Daxia Territory's Qi.

This will affect the development of the Zerg, but now is a critical moment for the development of the Great Xia Territory, so we can only invest ruthlessly in the hope that it will bring good returns.

Now that he was about to invest, Wu Qing was ruthless and let the lords of Daxia Territory directly expand the core area of protection to an area large enough to build a city where tens of thousands of people can live.

This operation consumed most of the energy gained from killing seven or eight thousand bugbears and lizardmen today.

Now that we have a safe zone, we can make do with the rest. Fortunately, Daxia led the team to go to the wild and get a lot of food in the past two days, otherwise everyone would be hungry.

"Lord, this city is left to everyone. This city needs everyone to work together to build it."

"The Lord's army will mark a safe zone. Everyone will find a place to settle down first. Food will be provided by the city."

The insect queen conveyed this notice to the refugees through the host.

Seeing that things have come to this, everyone can only accept it.

There is an absolutely safe zone free from weird interference, and many people are actually very satisfied.

At least there are military guards here and food supplies.

It's just that the gap between reality and imagination is a bit big, and everyone didn't get used to it for a while.

Who knew that a lord with so many mysterious armies could have such a poorly constructed city here.

All the people under the former Daxia leader returned to the city, and the Zerg army garrisoned the city gates and walls to isolate the refugees from the city.

In the camps prepared for the refugees outside the city, there are also Zerg stationed at certain distances.

The origins of these refugees are complicated, and we don’t know who will be among them.

People's hearts are full of different attitudes and cannot withstand the test, especially now that we are in a safe place and there are no external threats, many chaotic people will emerge.

Wu Qing didn't want to see these unpleasant things. With the threat of the Zerg, most people wouldn't dare to think otherwise.

In the city, the Queen of Insects issued a task, asking everyone to take out all the unfinished food, cook what should be cooked, and pack what does not need to be cooked, and send it to the refugees outside later.

This made the residents of Daxia Territory, who had just enjoyed sufficient food security, feel relieved and worried again.

"Don't worry, there will be more food tomorrow."

"A large number of people will join the Great Xia Territory. With enough manpower, we will build a big city!"

Hu Tu comforted loudly.

In a small city, the news spread instantly.

Everyone can only believe that after all, the new lord has not disappointed everyone yet.

Outside the city, the refugees camped in separate areas according to their own wishes under the guidance of their hosts.

This is true camping, where the vast majority of people have almost nothing.

Fortunately, the weather has been nice these days and the temperatures are comfortable, so we don’t have to endure the cold or heat.

Of these refugees, those who can reach here are basically young and middle-aged men, women and children, with the fewest elderly people.

Among ordinary people, young and middle-aged men are the fewest, and women and children are the majority. This may be the reason why young and middle-aged men have been recruited to defend the city.

For Wu Qing, regardless of gender, as long as they can work, it’s fine. The biggest role of young and middle-aged men is to fight, and he just doesn’t have this need.

Fighting is still the specialty of the Zerg, and other races should do more other things.

The refugees outside the city have nothing to camp, so they sit on the ground and just regard it as setting up camp.

There are many canals for diverting water to the fields outside the city, and there is no shortage of water.

There are fields next to it, and you can defecate and urinate as you like.

The conditions are limited, so we can only make do with this for the time being.

Before the sun sets, the residents in the city brought food in wheelbarrows. Except for the lack of meat, all kinds of food obtained in the wild were taken out.

The better food was distributed to children, the elderly and women first, and the others just ate some, as long as they were not hungry.

After surviving the catastrophe, everyone enjoyed the food for the first time, and it tasted especially sweet.

At night, many fires were lit outside the city, bringing some light to the dark night.

More Zerg troops arrived, constantly cleaning up the various weirdness that appeared in the weakened area of the Lord's shelter, and actively attracting the weirdness in the wild to clean up.

The Zerg's actions stunned the refugees outside the city.

"There are actually people who would actively cause trouble for the weirdness?!"

This is destined to be a sleepless night.
